<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# White at (35, 34), purple at (30, 35), dark gray at (27, 36).
# Click on purple diamond to continue the chain.

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find purple diamond
p_diamonds = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p' and n['pixels'] >= 10]
print(f"Purple diamonds: {len(p_diamonds)}")
for p in p_diamonds:
    center = (sum(b[0] for b in p['boundary'])//len(p['boundary']), sum(b[1] for b in p['boundary'])//len(p['boundary']))
    print(f"  pixels={p['pixels']}, center~{center}")

# Click on purple diamond
if p_diamonds:
    p = p_diamonds[0]
    center = (sum(b[0] for b in p['boundary'])//len(p['boundary']), sum(b[1] for b in p['boundary'])//len(p['boundary']))
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center[0], 'col': center[1]}])
    print(f"\nClicked purple at {center}")
    print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed', False)}")
    
    # Check state after
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes2 = seg2['nodes']
    print("\nObjects after:")
    for n in nodes2:
        if 5 <= n['pixels'] < 100:
            center = (sum(b[0] for b in n['boundary'])//len(n['boundary']), sum(b[1] for b in n['boundary'])//len(n['boundary']))
            print(f"  color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, center~{center}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
